ModMetaData.name: RimMT S5.2 NoResult Diagnostics
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Diagnostic-only sidecar for RimMT V0.4.19 JS1.1S5.1 TD1 on RimWorld 1.5. It does not replace RimMT and does not alter JobGiver search results. The first RimMT runtime-report action arms a bounded NoResult origin profiler; subsequent reports identify high-frequency repeated negative WorkGiver searches by def, concrete worker type, method, owning assembly, repeat interval, consecutive misses, and sampled CPU time.
